title: Quantum Steering and Entanglement in a Tritter: Hierarchy under Loss
summary: We present a comprehensive phase diagram of quantum correlations in a three-mode Gaussian state generated by a tritter, driven by a two-mode squeezed vacuum and a coherent state. The coherent amplitude does not affect the correlation structure, which is solely governed by the initial squeezing. By systematically analyzing five physically relevant asymmetric loss configurations, we map out the exact resilience thresholds for entanglement and Einstein-Podolsky-Rosen (EPR) steering under all bipartite partitions.
